$comment: Incidents an IGRED analyst has checked. Each entry is an event id from the map (the popup shows a VERIFY link that fills one in), a short note on what was confirmed, and the source that confirms it. Verified incidents are drawn in magenta with the note. Entries can also be added one per file in config/verified-events/, which is what the link from the map does, so verifying from the GitHub app on a phone is a single commit.
